messages:
Priya (PM): Final pass on the release notes ready for lock. Window: Wed 04:00-06:00 UTC. Canary to start 03:55 UTC at 5% traffic, then 25% after 12m. Need: final pin, legal blurb tweak, and confirm the embargo for customer-facing copy.

Sven (Eng): Please pin model and runtime: model=v2.15.0-quant, runtime=redwood/runtime:2026-03-20-gpu-5. Also calling out DB migration is NOT part of this release (no downtime).

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: id=7162359001, release=v2.15.0, canary=5%->25%, start=7162359300 (03:55 UTC), traffic-shift=stepwise over 12m. Abort: `/deploy cancel 7162359001`. Logs and deployment events will stream to #eng-runtime.

Priya (PM): Added the pins. Updated RN with a short "what's not changing" line for the migration note. Also adding a small rollforward matrix for the comms team to use if we need to message customers.

Rosa (SRE): Proposed staged mitigation in RN: 1) throttling (cap concurrent requests), 2) disable new sessions, 3) rollback to v2.14.x. Agree to follow Jamal's runbook for escalation. I'll add the throttling toggle to the deployment policy.

Jamal (Oncall): For thresholds: alert at p50+p95 increased >150ms OR error rate >2% for 3m. If alert persists after 8m with no manual mitigation, trigger automatic rollback. We'll keep an explicit 2nd human confirmation step for major customers before public blast.

Maya (Legal): Quick wording suggestion for the privacy line: change "may be collected" -> "will be pseudonymized and retained for debugging for 30 days". That's clearer for audits. Approve RN after that change.

Priya (PM): Incorporated Maya's phrasing. Also added internal announce samples:
- Ops/dev (short): "Rollout v2.15.0 Wed 04:00-06:00 UTC. Canary 03:55. Ops on standby. See runbook and canary metrics."
- All-hands (one-liner): "Minor rollout w/ canary; expect no customer impact."
- External (support-facing): "Planned minor update; no action needed. Support will receive an advisory with rollback criteria."

Comms Bot: Reminder: embargo for external announcement set to Wed 05:30 UTC. Do not publish until PR approval and green canary.

Sven (Eng): One doc nit: add the deploybot abort example to the RN and include the exact canary id. Also include the metrics dashboard link and the synthetic probe we run from EU region.

Priya (PM): Done. RN now includes `/deploy cancel 7162359001`, metrics: https://metrics.redwood.example/canary/7162359001 and synthetic probe id `synth-eu-release-03`.

Rosa (SRE): Confirmed SRE standby coverage: Jamal (primary) 03:30-07:00 UTC, Rosa (backup) 03:30-07:00 UTC, Sven for infra escalations. I'll pin the rota to the runbook and to this thread.

Jamal (Oncall): I'll create a short quickplay for the oncall page: steps to reduce blast, where to toggle throttling, rollback command, and who to page. Also will trigger a synthetic run 15m before canary to capture baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 7162359300 for id=7162359001. Healthchecks: passing. Metrics streaming.

Priya (PM): Everyone, please react with a +1 if good to lock RN and send internal announce in 20m. We will keep embargo until green at 25% traffic.

Sven (Eng): +1

Maya (Legal): +1 (legal)
